name: Semaphore
flavor: Home and distant arms on a post. Danger with the arm level, clear with it raised. Place on track.

name: Water Tower
flavor: Nearby stations load faster and fill water tanks completely.

name: Coaling Stage
flavor: Nearby stations fill fuel tanks completely instead of a half top-up.

name: Power Line
flavor: Carries power along the rails. Chain poles within reach of each other and of a Power Plant.

name: Townhouse
flavor: Homes for six. With a warehouse near a town station it founds a town; more houses mean more people, more passengers and more mouths to feed.
